# Support

## How to get help

1. Read the docs in your language: `README`, `STEP-BY-STEP` and
   `collection/FORMS-INSTRUCTIONS` (each has `.pt-br.md` and `.es.md`
   copies).
2. Check the FAQ on the
   [project site](https://gbb-acelerators.github.io/ai-maturity-client-kit/).
3. Run `make smoke` to check the prerequisites, and `make demo` to confirm
   the report pipeline works with the mock data.
4. Search the
   [existing issues](https://github.com/gbb-acelerators/ai-maturity-client-kit/issues).
   If none matches, open a new issue with the bug report or feature request
   form.

Never attach client data to an issue. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Support policy

This kit is maintained on a best-effort basis. It is not a Microsoft
product and has no service-level agreement.
